description: Turn a VIDEO into WRITTEN pieces: a summary, YouTube chapters (first at 0:00, at least 3, each 10s+), chapter summaries, an X thread (every post under 280 characters), a blog post, timestamped verbatim quotes, or any piece in your own words (pass the words as a format). The video: a YouTube link (read from its captions), a video file URL, a Library id, an upload_file URL or a social post link (read by watching it); or the text itself, when you already have it from analyze_video (which is the tool that just reads a video back). Several formats share ONE read. Priced by the video's length before anything is spent: without confirm it returns the exact credits and spends nothing; confirm:true writes and charges exactly that. Only the paid minutes are read. Every piece is written only from what the video says. Built-in skills youtube_script and retention_skeleton (get_skill) write long-form scripts.

confirm.description: true only after the user agreed to the quoted price

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

formats.description: summary, chapters, chapter_summaries, thread, blog, quotes, or any piece in your own words; default summary

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

includeTranscript.description: also return the transcript that was read

instructions.description: your direction for every piece: audience, tone, length, a call to action

language.description: the language to write in, when not English

model.description: a Claude id from hermoso_capabilities (Fable 5.2: paid plans only); omit for the default

read.description: 'watch' reads a YouTube video by watching it rather than from its captions (one with no captions)

seconds.description: the video length in seconds, when you know it: it prices exactly that, and anything past it is not read

transcript.description: the transcript text, when you already have it; then nothing is read

video.description: a YouTube link, a video file URL, a Library id (L0…), an upload_file URL or a social post link

name: repurpose_transcript
title: Repurpose a video transcript
